title: Public evidence access
required_acceptance_detail: Anonymous visitor opens a public event and can inspect actual permitted source links, timestamps and metrics; private records are absent.

title: Secure sign-out
required_acceptance_detail: Sign out returns to anonymous access; prior private watchlist/chat/notifications are removed from visible client state and private requests fail. FR-006 is contextual, not a dedicated sign-out function.

title: No mandatory quantity or cost basis
Event type
required_acceptance_detail: Shown event type matches normalized event type and is understandable in Turkish.

title: Why detected
required_acceptance_detail: Event explains actual trigger value, baseline/window and limitation; inspect numeric evidence if AI unavailable.

title: Evidence inspection
required_acceptance_detail: User can inspect each displayed supporting metric with units, timestamp and source evidence.

title: Network transparency
required_acceptance_detail: On-chain display includes exact chain and contract/mint/native identity, data coverage and token-account/owner uncertainty; no complete ownership claim from partial accounts.

title: Asset-aware conversation
required_acceptance_detail: Opening chat on asset A and asking an asset-implicit question resolves A; selecting event B supplies that event without cross-asset or cross-user context.

title: Project data usage
required_acceptance_detail: Answer about current asset uses bounded structured project observations/event evidence; actual tool evidence supports every material numeric claim.

title: Conversational drill-down
required_acceptance_detail: Follow-up asks about selected event/history/source and preserves asset/origin/cutoff with inspectable supporting evidence or abstention.

title: In-app notifications
required_acceptance_detail: Eligible event creates only the intended user in-app record; read/unread state persists and another user cannot access it.

title: Immediate high-importance e-mail
required_acceptance_detail: With gates cleared and fresh consent, eligible high/critical personal or released critical global event sends via outbox; no opt-in/unsubscribe/replay produces no external send. Dry-run is not delivery acceptance.

title: Alert sensitivity preference
required_acceptance_detail: User selects a sensitivity mode, it persists, and only eligible severity levels produce personal in-app/email according to separate channel consent.

title: Digest e-mail
required_acceptance_detail: Digest includes only eligible lower-urgency events for the consented user in the selected time window; duplicate/retry/unsubscribe/replay guards apply; exact cadence remains owner choice.

title: No browser push requirement
required_acceptance_detail: Manual feature review confirms no browser-push dependency or mandatory browser permission for MVP functions. No existing named acceptance case directly covers this exclusion.

title: Event relevance feedback
required_acceptance_detail: Signed-in user records useful/not useful on the selected event; persisted value belongs to that user/event.

title: Feedback without friction
required_acceptance_detail: A single click/tap/keyboard activation submits relevance feedback without mandatory form; optional detail remains optional.

title: Feedback history for improvement
required_acceptance_detail: Feedback records persist with user/event/value/time; authorized aggregation is usefulness evidence, never detector accuracy ground truth.

title: Event monitoring
required_acceptance_detail: Authorized admin sees recent and high/critical events with truthful severity/evidence strength; non-admin is denied.

title: Product metrics
required_acceptance_detail: Authorized admin sees defined minimal metrics computed from actual records, with periods and data-mode separation; no invented counts.

title: Controlled configuration
required_acceptance_detail: Admin changes only bounded typed allowlisted settings; server rejects invalid/unauthorized values and records actor/before/after/version.

title: AI configuration visibility
required_acceptance_detail: Admin can inspect active model/config/prompt version and associated event/call versions without secret values.

title: Turkish product language
required_acceptance_detail: Core high-visibility screens render natural Turkish by default, with human-approved terminology; English engineering identifiers do not leak as UI copy.

title: Progressive disclosure
required_acceptance_detail: Concise event summary is understandable first; expanded metrics/method/source remain keyboard/touch accessible.

title: Deliberate visual design
required_acceptance_detail: Designer-approved direction, representative-screen screenshot review and actual available Impeccable findings are recorded; generic patterns fixed and final approval documented.

title: Responsive web usability
required_acceptance_detail: At 390/768/1440px essential source/time/evidence/limitations remain reachable without overflow, hover dependence or trapped mobile scroll.

title: Historical anomaly replay
required_acceptance_detail: Rights-cleared real historical case replays reproducibly from contemporaneously available evidence and shows the actual detected event. Synthetic mechanics are labeled and do not satisfy this historical-proof requirement.

title: Current/live capability proof
required_acceptance_detail: Entitled current or near-current provider response is actually observed with source/venue/time/delay. Frozen replay or synthetic fixtures alone do not satisfy current-fetch proof.

title: Explainable replay
required_acceptance_detail: Replay and current normalized events use the same evidence/severity/heuristic-score/explanation contract, with visibly distinct origin and replay cutoff.
